declarations.name: BkTooltip

slots.description: The trigger element (must be focusable for keyboard users).

declarations.summary:
Tooltip for the slotted trigger. Opens on hover and keyboard focus, stays open while
hovered, and closes on Escape (WCAG 1.4.13). The text is exposed to assistive technology as
the trigger's description via a light-DOM element, so it works across shadow roots.

declarations.name: injectTokens
declarations.description:
Add the token stylesheet to the document once. Uses a constructable stylesheet when possible
(works under strict CSP without 'unsafe-inline'), otherwise a <style data-bk-tokens> tag.
Token selectors use :where() so any app-level override wins.
